stories.title: JetBrains releases Mellum2.1 Instruct, an open coding model for sub-agents
stories.summary: It is a 12B mixture-of-experts model with 2.5B active parameters, released under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face with GGUF files and an MTP head that speeds generation up to 1.8x; it generates about half as many tokens as the Thinking variant on agentic coding tasks.
stories.why: A small open model he could run locally as a fast worker in coding-agent loops.

stories.title: Anthropic details moving its Messages API from Python to Rust with agents checking parity
stories.summary: Claude wrote a first version of the core request path in about a week; the Rust API uses about 70% less CPU per request and cuts median time to first token by about 20%, with no downtime.
stories.why: A concrete case study of using production traffic as a verifier for AI-written code, a pattern he can reuse when migrating live systems.

stories.title: Nigerian cybersecurity startup Aeon extends pre-seed round to $2 million
stories.summary: The extension follows a $1 million round in September and will fund hiring in engineering and cybersecurity; its products are Aeon Console, an AI-powered compliance platform, and Aeon Edge, a network security device.
stories.why: An African AI-security startup that says it is expanding its engineering team.

stories.title: Ten startups, seven of them Kenyan, named finalists for Latitude59 Kenya pitch competition
stories.summary: Chosen from a record 509 applications from 25 countries, the finalists pitch in Nairobi on December 4; the winner gets a fast track to the Latitude59 2027 TOP30 in Tallinn.
stories.why: A list of Nairobi-pitching startups, including AI and payments names like Farmsky and ElementPay, worth watching for outreach.

stories.title: SAP reportedly weighs at least 10,000 job cuts in AI-driven restructuring
stories.summary: Bloomberg reported the cuts would affect at least 9% of SAP's global workforce and could change after labour negotiations; Reuters could not verify it and SAP declined to comment.
stories.why: Another large software employer reshaping around AI, which keeps pressure on junior engineering hiring.

stories.title: Report finds AI-exposed industries hiring fewer beginners rather than laying people off
stories.summary: In the industries using AI most, the share of postings open to candidates with three years of experience or less was 3-8% below the 2021-2026 average for the year ending June 2026.
stories.why: Supports leading with shipped projects, since entry-level postings are shrinking where AI use is heaviest.

stories.title: Kenyan prosecutors drop criminal case against FlexPay executives in Naivas dispute
stories.summary: The ODPP found the KES 31.2 million ($240,000) dispute civil in nature and told Naivas to seek redress in court, after a five-year partnership that processed more than KES 3 billion in customer transactions.
stories.why: A warning on partner-remittance and settlement terms in Kenyan fintech integrations.

stories.title: Safaricom adds OTP verification before beneficiaries can be added to Shiriki Pay
stories.summary: Sponsors now get a one-time password on their registered number, receive transaction notifications and can remove a beneficiary at any time.
stories.why: A real example of confirmation and notification controls on a shared-wallet payments feature.

stories.title: NCBA digital loan disbursements rise 27% to Sh1.29 trillion in nine months
stories.summary: Fuliza, offered with Safaricom's M-Pesa, accounted for Sh1.1 trillion of Kenya disbursements; M-Shwari rose 5.45% to Sh75.4 billion.
stories.why: Shows the scale of mobile-money credit rails that Kenyan fintech engineering work plugs into.
